name: ofrecord
description: Brief an executive search from your AI assistant. Of Record researches real public profiles against the role and returns a ranked, fully sourced shortlist and report.

interface.shortDescription: Executive search shortlists, researched and sourced
interface.longDescription: Describe the role you need to fill. You confirm the brief once; Of Record writes a research plan, researches real people with a public professional presence, and returns a ranked shortlist in which every fact links to its source. The full report also arrives by email as a PDF.
defaultPrompt: Run an Of Record search for a Head of Tax in Abu Dhabi
